MStype_prompt.notes: The study focuses on a microproteomics workflow for FFPE tissues using Laser Capture Microdissection (LCM). While the search parameters included phosphorylation and hydroxylation, there was no specific PTM-enrichment step (e.g., TiO2 or IMAC); instead, the sample preparation was specifically optimized to enrich for the Extracellular Matrix (ECM) using heat extraction and urea-based buffers. No standard ontology modifier for 'ECM' was provided in the context, so it is listed as a general target.
